title: Cactus Hybrid: We taught Gemma 4 to know when it's wrong
claim: Show HN: Cactus Hybrid: We taught Gemma 4 to know when it's wrong
why_good: Teaches Gemma-4 to know when it's wrong (calibrated uncertainty) — tackles hallucination/confidence, one of the most valuable open problems.
value: Calibration/uncertainty could sell as a safety layer to enterprises that need trustworthy model outputs; API or fine-tune.
risk: Frontier labs are attacking calibration directly; a small team must show a durable, transferable method, not one model.

zh.claim: Show HN: Cactus Hybrid —— 我们教会 Gemma 4 知道自己什么时候错了。
zh.why_good: 教 Gemma-4 知道自己何时出错(校准的不确定性)——攻的是幻觉/置信度,最有价值的开放问题之一。
zh.value: 校准/不确定性可作为安全层卖给需要可信模型输出的企业;API 或微调。
zh.risk: 前沿实验室在直接攻校准;小团队要证明一个持久、可迁移的方法,而非单个模型。
